per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be easy to use, with 95% of adjusters and estimators reporting it is easy to use in surveys.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. 95% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators shall find the product easy to use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The recycled parts search should respond within 15 seconds, with a preference for faster response times.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should locate a preferred repair facility in under 8 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have high availability, with a target of 98% availability over the year.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should handle up to 1,500 concurrent users at peak times without performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be able to handle up to 1500 simultaneous users. The system shall perform with 1500 users as a time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Each insurance company must only see their own claims and related data, with no cross-visibility.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'One insurance company shall not be able to view another insurance companys claim data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support different roles with varying levels of access, such as read-only and full edit rights.
The system should be resilient to attempts to break or overload it, with protections against denial of service and automated scraping.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should integrate with the Choice Parts feed for parts data.
